About

I’m a backend and platform engineer with more than a decade of experience building developer infrastructure and distributed systems. I founded the Workers KV team at Cloudflare and began my career supporting an anti-money-laundering deployment at Palantir.

I graduated from the University of Texas at Austin’s five-year BS/MS program in Computer Science and have worked in Seoul, Singapore, New York, Austin, and Boston.

Current work

At Circle, I lead development of an internal AI platform for securely deploying and operating agent-based applications, including LLM access, RAG, tool integration, authorization, and observability.

Outside work

I enjoy strength training, cardio, and PC gaming. I live in Boston with my wife and our cat.
